title: Andrew Basiago claims he went back to the Gettysburg Address
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Andrew Basiago claims he went back to the Gettysburg Address, about 1863 at Gettysburg, Pennsylvania, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Andrew Bosiago let's just get clear he literally says I went back to the Gettysburg address.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes Andrew Basiago, a man who claims he took part in secret government time travel. Michels stresses that Basiago literally says he went back to 1863 to see the Gettysburg Address, Abraham Lincoln's famous speech in Pennsylvania during the American Civil War. If it were true, it would mean the government had working time travel decades ago.
